info.title: Queue OpenAPI for kling/v4/image-to-image
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the kling/v4/image-to-image queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Generate images from reference images and elements with Kling Image 4.0.

items.limit_description: Max file size: 30.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: Turn @Image1 into a photorealistic product render.
prompt.description: Text prompt. Reference images as @Image1, @Image2, ... and elements as @Element1, @Element2, ...

series_amount.title: Series Amount
series_amount.description: Number of images in the series (2-10), or 'auto' to let the model choose. Only used when result_type is 'series'.

elements.title: Elements
elements.description: Elements, referenced as @Element1, @Element2, ... (max 7). Images and elements combined must not exceed 10.

result_type.description: 'single' returns independent images; 'series' returns a coherent set of related images.
result_type.title: Result Type

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of generated images. 'auto' picks one from the input content.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

num_images.description: Number of independent images to generate (1-9). Only used when result_type is 'single'.
num_images.title: Num Images

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI.

images.title: Images
images.description: The generated images. A series is returned in order.

items.limit_description: Max file size: 30.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

reference_image_urls.description: Additional views of the element from different angles (1-3).
reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls

frontal_image_url.title: Frontal Image Url
frontal_image_url.description:
The frontal image of the element (main view).

Max file size: 30.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
